family.amstrad-series-4.description: Amstrad’s compact offering for the professional desktop in 1991.
family.amstrad-series-4.history: Series 4 brought Amstrad’s professional PC into a smaller format with the PC4386SX. Presented at CeBIT in March 1991 alongside the ANB-386SX and ACL-386SX portables, it combined a small screen, hard disk and graphical environment for office work. The brochure offered MS-DOS 3.3, Windows 3 and Amstrad Manager. It aimed to free up desk space while retaining expansion options.
